description: Create a Monitor in a project, initially disabled. An enabled Monitor runs on its schedule, unattended. Its Cycles burn Fuel unless the account has a plan that includes monitoring, which covers them up to its limits. Enable it with enable_monitor at the "Launch" access level; below that level a call is refused, and the user enables it in the Dashboard at the link the returned summary carries. Read the 'monitoring' topic before choosing a frequency or thresholds.

engineIds.description: The ids of the monitoring locations the Cycles run from, as list_monitoring_locations reports them; at least one is required. Monitoring locations are their own set, not the load test regions list_engines offers, and an unknown id is refused with an error naming the valid ones.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failed Cycles before an Incident opens (1 to 128; default 1).

frequency.description: How often a Cycle runs, in milliseconds: 60000 (one minute) to 86400000 (one day).

recoveryThreshold.description: Consecutive passing Cycles before an open Incident closes (1 to 128; default 1).

scriptId.description: The id of the Script in this project the Monitor plays each Cycle.

tags.description: Tag names; a name the team doesn't have yet becomes a new tag. Omit for no tags.

thresholds.description: The acceptable-metric limits a Cycle is judged against, each optional within the object: responseTimeAverageMin/Max, responseTimeTotalMin/Max, cycleDurationMin/Max, timeToFirstByteMax, firstContentfulPaintMax, largestContentfulPaintMax, and totalBlockingTimeMax in milliseconds; cumulativeLayoutShiftMax as the unitless Web Vitals score; performanceScoreMin as the 0-100 floor. A limit left out of the object is not checked.

name: create_monitor
title: Create Monitor
